The symposium. If you follow the heteronymic theory far enough, it has no bottom. Plato and aristotle can be read as heteronyms, then why not Aristophanes? Xenophanes? Why not Sappho herself? It is one connected authorial system. It is coherent amongst and between itself. It is consonant with the lifetime output of a logos-possessed writer. You see? That is not even implausible, once you know what you're looking at
